newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates down after fund injection.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates down after fund injection.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were softer at midday on Thursday after T$16.7 billion worth of fund injection into the banking system on Wednesday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 5.412 percent against Wednesday's 5.483 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.35-5.45 against 5.50. Dealers said they did not expect major rate falls ahead as T$8-10 billion of business tax collection would emerge in the next five days to tighten liquidity.
Government bond yields fell slightly on technical corrections after recent rises, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.825 against 5.840.
